# `aitbc market gpu list`

List GPUs in the coordinator registry (GET /v1/market/gpu/list).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market gpu list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--status` | choice | — | no | Filter by GPU status (default: all) |
| `--price-max` | float | — | no | Maximum price_per_hour |
| `--region` | text | — | no | Filter by region (case-insensitive) |
| `--model` | text | — | no | Filter by model substring |
| `--limit` | integer | `100` | no | Max rows (server cap 500) |
| `--json-output` | flag | `false` | no | Output raw JSON |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market gpu list
```
